Context: (c) Clarification on grant of advance -

## (c) Clarification on grant of advance -  
- (i) In case of treatment procedures without package rates, the admissible amount is calculated item-wise at CGHS rate. Items for which there are no CGHS rates, AIIMS rates shall be considered. If there is no CGHS / AIIMS rate, actual estimate for the procedure will be considered.
- (ii) The hospital seeking advance shall provide item-wise break-up of the estimate to facilitate processing of request for medical advance.
